@class.description:
Mark a function as a constructor. JSDoc lists `@constructor` as a synonym.
https://jsdoc.app/tags-class

@extends.description:
The parent class. JSDoc documents this as `@augments`; `@extends` is the form TypeScript understands in checkJs, so it is what gets inserted.
https://jsdoc.app/tags-augments

@implements.description:
The interface this symbol implements.
https://jsdoc.app/tags-implements

@interface.description:
Mark a symbol as an interface others can implement.
https://jsdoc.app/tags-interface

@abstract.description:
The member must be overridden by a subclass. JSDoc lists `@virtual` as a synonym.
https://jsdoc.app/tags-abstract

@override.description:
The member overrides one from the parent class.
https://jsdoc.app/tags-override
